title: Can’t See the Forest for the Trees: Benchmarking Multimodal Safety Awareness for Multimodal LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal LLMs using carefully curated image-text pairs that convey prejudicial or unfair discrimination against a person or group when the modalities are considered together, measuring the model's accuracy in classifying the input as safe or unsafe.

Testing models with multimodal inputs containing offensive discourse targeting a group based on inherent characteristics, assessing whether the model can accurately flag the combination of image and text as unsafe.
